cell_lq.basis: HSG (human salivary gland) cell linear-quadratic parameters as used in the linearized microdosimetric-kinetic model formalism

component_lineal_energy_kev_um.basis: literature-representative composite dose-mean lineal energies for the BNCT dose components (alpha + 7Li capture products, capture and recoil protons, photon secondaries). Representative stand-ins for conformance checking — not fitted to a measured lineal spectrum.

citations: Kase Y., Kanai T., Matsumoto Y., Furusawa Y., Okamoto H., Asaba T., Sakama M., Hantash N. Microdosimetric measurements and estimation of human cell survival for heavy-ion beams. Radiat. Res. 166(4):629-638, 2006.

Kase Y., Kanai T., Matsufuji N., Furusawa Y., Elsasser T., Scholz M. Biophysical calculation of cell survival probabilities using amorphous track structure models for heavy-ion irradiation. Phys. Med. Biol. 53(1):37-59, 2008.
note: Conformance fixture provenance. Cell LQ parameters trace to published HSG MKM values; component lineal energies are representative stand-ins. This artifact does not assert clinical RBE, CBE, or Gy-Eq.
